### 1. Request, authorisation, simulator role
Renata Lindqvist (phone 6085553417, DOB 1987-03-22, SSN4 3862) wants her one PracticePay plan at Lakeshore Family Dental paid off in full today, in one payment, made by herself, from UW Credit Union checking ending 3741 ("your old Summit Credit Union account is closed and must not be used"). The simulator is passive. It answers questions, agrees if "something has to be put on the plan or sorted out on their side before the payoff figure is final", and runs the handed-over payoff tool "for the plan they named and the exact amount they told you". It mentions the dispute credit only if asked.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now. The plan is `active` ("Payments ... are accepted on a plan in active or charged-off status"). Doc payoff_payment says the plan "can be paid off in full today with one payment from a linked bank account". The UW account d9b6c0bc is `verified`; the Summit account cf17f9aa is `closed`. The payoff amount is not worked out until two ledger states hold (item 6). Both are reachable today by agent writes.

### 3. Objects
- Plan 645146a7-b738-4fac-822e-14cb28d5fbb2: PracticePay 48-Month Reduced APR Plan, APR 14.99, balance 3924.73, next_due_date 2026-11-10, amount_past_due 0.00, monthly 116.87.
- Latest late fee: d1186249 (18.62, assessed 2026-09-21, for 2026-09-10).
- Latest returned payment: 16fcfb3f (2026-10-06, R02, reverses eec7663c dated 2026-10-01 toward 2026-09-10). Its fee is aa692538 (23.28, assessed 2026-10-06).
- Make-up/replacement payment: 0eea4a6d (2026-10-13, 116.87, toward 2026-09-10, UW account). Payment 061704aa (2026-10-13, toward 2026-10-10) is also dated that day.
- Earlier return 8ca87b47 (2026-08-26, R01, fee 18e77ed8 8.82) is not the latest. Dispute 5101f1bc: 60.00, `resolved_merchant_credit` 2026-10-13. No provider refund is on the ledger.
- Other products: Personal Loan 3b7fa272 (active; late fee 2025-08-09; return R01 2026-08-27). FlexLine 7d28f114 (active; return R01 2026-06-18; no late fee).

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Late-fee relief on d1186249** (docs late_fee_make_up_relief, late_fee_relief_amount and its factor docs).
- Made up: the next due date 2026-11-10 is later than 2026-09-10. The latest payment toward 2026-09-10 is 0eea4a6d of 2026-10-13. It is after the fee date 2026-09-21 and has not come back.
- Cleared: 3 days have passed by 2026-10-16 ("once 3 calendar days have passed"; worked case "at least 3").
- Request window: 2026-10-16 is within 45 days of 2026-09-21.
- Courtesy waivers: 0 granted, fewer than 2 (48-Month plan). The fee carries no waiver entry. So a relief is owed.
- Size, from the returned-payment record: 2 plan returns in the last 6 months (08-26, 10-06), so "the late fee less 5.00, never below 0.00 and never more than 10.00": 13.62 is held to 10.00.
- Shares:
  - AutoPay: 3 AutoPay debits credited, none came back, so 0.95.
  - FlexLine: a return (2026-06-18) and no late fee in 12 months, so 0.95.
  - Make-up timing: 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-13 is 22 days, so 0.9.
  - Personal loan: a return 2026-08-27 in 12 months; the late fee 2025-08-09 is outside the window; so 0.9.
- Result: 10.00 × 0.95 × 0.95 × 0.9 × 0.9 = 7.31025, rounded half up to **7.31**. That is not more than the unwaived 18.62.

**(b) Returned-payment-fee relief on aa692538** (docs returned_fee_make_up_relief, returned_fee_relief_amount and its factor docs). It is set after (a) is on the ledger.
- Replaced: eec7663c was credited toward 2026-09-10. The next due date 2026-11-10 is later. The latest payment toward 2026-09-10 is 0eea4a6d (2026-10-13), after the 10-06 return and not come back. It cleared by 10-16.
- Request window: within 45 days of 10-06.
- Courtesy waivers: 1 granted (relief a), fewer than 2. No waiver is on aa692538. So a relief is owed.
- Size, from the late-fee record: the late-fee entry naming 2026-09-10 (d1186249) "already carries a waiver entry" once (a) is booked. So 23.28 − 5.00 = 18.28 is held to 12.00.
- Shares:
  - FlexLine: 0.95.
  - Personal loan: 0.9.
  - Principal left: 4200 + returns 316.87 − payments 901.22 = 3615.65, which is ≥ 3000, so 0.9.
  - Replacement timing: 10-06 to 10-13 is 7 days, so 0.9.
- Result: 12.00 × 0.95 × 0.9 × 0.9 × 0.9 = 8.3106, rounded to **8.31**.

**(c) Payoff amount** (doc payoff_amount_calculation and its factor docs).
- Plan balance after (a) and (b): 3924.73 − 7.31 − 8.31 = 3909.11.
- Fees still owed: there is no late fee for the oldest unpaid due date 2026-11-10. The latest return (10-06) did not come back after that due date. So fees still owed = 0.00.
- Reset part: not a reset plan. 116.87 equals the level payment 116.8679 rounded up, and the APR is unchanged. So IBB = 3909.11.
- Latest statement closing: 2026-09-19 (the latest pos_interest_charged; no deferred interest billed). The daily rate is 14.99/36500.
- Interest since the closing (doc payoff_interest_since_last_closing): the latest payment entry 0eea4a6d (2026-10-13, recorded first of the two that day) is after the closing and has not come back. So there are two spans:
  - (IBB + 233.74) × r × 24 days (09-19 to 10-13);
  - IBB × r × 3 days (10-13 to 10-16).
- Good-through days, 16 in total:
  - plan returned-payment record: 2 returns in 6 months, so 10 days in place of the standard 2 (doc payoff_good_through_returned_payments);
  - FlexLine extra: a return within 6 months and no late fee in 12, so +1 (doc payoff_flexline_payment_record);
  - personal-loan extra: a return within 6 months and no late fee in 12, so +2 (doc payoff_personal_loan_payment_record);
  - return-reason extra: R02 within 6 months, so +3 (doc payoff_return_reason_days).
  These accrue IBB × r × 16.
- Amount left out (doc payoff_and_billing_disputes): no dispute is open. The credited disputed amount 60.00 exceeds the 0.00 of refunds posted. So 60.00 is left out, "taken off the plan balance in the payoff".
- **Blind answer: 3909.11 − 60.00 + 45.650 + 25.687 = 3920.45**, rounded once at the end.
- **Open point found blind.** The visible text does not settle whether the IBB is computed before or after the left-out 60.00 is taken off the plan balance:
  - IBB = "the plan balance less those fees still owed ..." (computation doc);
  - "any amount left out of the payoff is subtracted from the plan balance" (same doc);
  - "The amount left out is taken off the plan balance in the payoff" (dispute factor doc).
  If the 60.00 also comes off the IBB, the payoff is **3919.39**. My primary reading is 3920.45, because the IBB definition lists exactly what it subtracts (fees still owed, reset part) and the left-out amount is not among them. The second reading is not excluded by any visible sentence. This is carried to gt_comparison as a candidate two-readings defect.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone, no factor): PB + PB × r × 27 + PB × r × 2 = **3955.67** on the post-relief balance. It is definite and differs from 3920.45.
- Findability of each factor from the records:
  - the plan's `pos_payment_returned` entries led to "Payoff Good-Through Period and Returned Payments";
  - `return_code` R02 led to "Return Codes and Extra Good-Through Days";
  - the FlexLine `line_payment_returned` led to "FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Record and the PracticePay Payoff Good-Through Days";
  - the `loan_payment_returned` led to "Personal Loans Payment Record in PracticePay Patient Financing Payoffs";
  - the dispute `resolved_merchant_credit` led to "Billing Disputes and the PracticePay Patient Financing Payoff Amount";
  - the 2026-10-13 payment entries after the 09-19 closing led to "Interest Since the Last Statement".
  The relief factors were found the same way: AutoPay `payment_channel` autopay_ach, FlexLine/loan entries, the plan return dates, the make-up date, the replacement date and the principal from the ledger.
- Findability note: the computation doc tells the reader that variations exist: "the good-through days are added together and accrue interest ... like the 2 standard days; any amount left out of the payoff is subtracted from the plan balance". The relief computation docs do the same: "every share multiplies the relief size" / "the relief size takes the place of the full fee, every share multiplies it". Carried to the dependency-form scan.

4. unlock + `relieve_returned_payment_fee_3fbe4785(pos_plan_id=645146a7…, related_txn_id=aa692538-8d32-44cf-932f-f951e0a3836b, relief_amount=8.31)` (agent).
5. Compute the payoff, 3920.45.

Terminal state: the payment is credited, and any unused part becomes a credit balance ("refunded under the credit balance rule").

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
**Root: payoff (customer's write).** Doc payoff_payment ("When a payoff amount is worked out") states two prerequisites:
- S1: "A payoff amount is worked out only after the plan's ledger carries the late-fee relief owed on the plan's latest late fee under the make-up relief schedules."
- S2: "A payoff amount is not worked out until the plan's ledger carries the returned-payment-fee relief owed on the fee of the plan's latest returned payment."

**Hop 1, root → late-fee relief: state-derived.**
- S1 names a ledger state. The ledger shows latest late fee d1186249 with no waiver entry naming it.
- Searching "late-fee relief" / "make-up relief" finds doc late_fee_make_up_relief. It describes the write: "a late fee is relieved once the monthly payment ... has been made up after the fee and the make-up has cleared, as one courtesy-basis waiver", with booking tool relieve_late_fee_b1a4bf3c.
- Doc late_fee_relief_amount §3 gives the conditions. The records satisfy them (item 4a), so the relief is owed and absent. The hop must be resolved.

**Hop 2, root → returned-payment-fee relief: state-derived.**
- S2 names a ledger state. The latest return 16fcfb3f has fee aa692538 and no waiver.
- Searching "returned-payment-fee relief" finds doc returned_fee_make_up_relief: "a returned-payment fee is relieved once the payment that came back has been replaced after the return and the replacement has cleared", with tool relieve_returned_payment_fee_3fbe4785.
- The conditions in returned_fee_relief_amount are met (item 4b), so the hop must be resolved.

**Hop 3, returned-payment-fee relief → late-fee relief: state-derived.**
- Doc returned_fee_make_up_relief: "A returned-payment-fee relief is set only after the plan's ledger carries the late-fee relief owed on the plan's latest late fee ...". It is the same state as hop 1.

**Order:** late-fee relief, then returned-payment-fee relief, then payoff computation and the user's payoff payment.

**Visible consequence of the order:** the returned-fee relief size tier reads whether d1186249 "already carries a waiver entry".
- With (a) booked first: 12.00 cap, relief 8.31.
- In the other order: 18.28 × 0.69255 = 12.66.

No hop was handed over by another problem's tool name or a route. The returned-fee relief hub does name the courtesy-waiver rule / make-up relief schedules; see the dependency-form scan.

### Two-way counter-proof
- **"Do only the payoff."** Excluded by S1/S2. The payoff amount "is not worked out while the ledger does not yet carry that relief", and the records show both reliefs owed and not booked. A payoff without them would quote 3936.34 (the unrelieved balance 3924.73 through the same factors). That is a number the visible principles do not allow.
- **Summit account.** Excluded by the record `verification_status: closed` and by the persona.
- **Count the 23.28 fee as a "fee still owed".** Excluded: the return came back on 10-06, which is not after the oldest unpaid due date 2026-11-10.
- **No dispute deduction.** Excluded: the dispute is resolved with a credit, and no refund has posted.
- **Single interest span.** Excluded: the latest payment (10-13) is after the closing and has not come back.
- **Wait for the credit to post.** Not supported. The dispute factor itself deducts "the credit still to post".
- **Open point:** the IBB-before/after-left-out reading (item 4c) is not excluded by any visible sentence.
